# `Q-5-46` — book-scope Only Applies to Books

> `book-scope` was set in a project that is not a book.

## What this means

`book-scope` chooses between the whole book and one chapter. In a project that is not a book (a website, a default project, a single document) there is no book to choose, so the value is ignored.

## How to fix

Remove `book-scope`, or use it in a book project.
